description:
Nothing is published yet - no tag, nothing pushed. Everything upstream of a tag
is free to break; everything after it is not.

Prerequisites: the API is settled (see the review cards), the README teaches the
model in one screen, and CI is green on linux/macos/windows.

The two ports (memri, rad LSP) are the acceptance test and both pass, so the
release gate is about surface stability, not correctness.
